nodes.label: Standalone repo mode (repo_root)
nodes.rationale: Introduced as a parallel storage root to wiki mode so a manuscript project can exist with no wiki-manager dependency at all; repo_root and wiki_root are two storage roots, not a migration path, and either works end to end alone.

nodes.label: registry.jsonl canonical paper registry
nodes.rationale: Appraisals are stored per-project rather than as a single field on the paper, because risk-of-bias/applicability judgement is a function of the review question the paper is being used to answer, not an intrinsic property of the paper — the same paper can be appraised for one manuscript and not_appraised for another simultaneously.
